headline: US Employment Data Set to Impact Mexican Peso and Brazilian Real
summary: Upcoming US employment data releases are expected to influence the Mexican peso and Brazilian real by shifting Federal Reserve rate expectations and capital flows.
why: US economic data releases are critical drivers for emerging market currencies as they dictate Federal Reserve monetary policy expectations and global dollar liquidity.

impacts.name: Mexican peso
impacts.why: US macroeconomic data shifts Federal Reserve expectations, directly impacting emerging market currencies like the Mexican peso.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

impacts.name: Brazilian real
impacts.why: US employment reports alter dollar flows and risk sentiment, affecting the Brazilian real.
